scope: Published OBV rule component, not full paper replication, not a complete stop/TP1 alert contract
rules: OBV adds completed-bar base volume if close>=previous close, subtracts otherwise. Flat close therefore adds volume as in paper. Long if short SMA(OBV)>=long SMA(OBV), cash otherwise. No shorts.
execution: Completed bar known at end; earliest proxy fill is following minute open after one minute publication buffer. Returns use original minute open-to-next-open. Long/cash 1x normalized return model, no leverage. No source hard stop/TP1. Not an actual futures fill simulation.

costs.funding: Archived adverse long funding only, applied before position changes at settlement using simple-return proxy
costs.stress: Double fee and slippage on same monthly selection; do not refit stress winner

selection: Each UTC month select best1 and best50 by prior12 calendar months net log return; deterministic parameter-order tie; at least9 complete usable training months. Fixed equal capital sleeves, no intra-month rebalance; liquidate and restart sleeves at monthly boundaries, charging costs. Same universe common quality coverage, no pick-best test rule.
data: Verified Binance USD-M BTCUSDT original minute, 2022 warmup/2023 train and 2024-Jan through 2026-Sep exploratory evaluation; all periods previously observed for other hypotheses
integrity: Previously quarantined minute intervals split histories; require192 full60m bars before common usable coverage after a gap. A month is included only if every original minute is present and full prior context is known throughout. Exclude incomplete months wholly before returns. No synthetic gap liquidation or zero-filled unknown PnL.
disclosures: Three intraday frequencies and unfiltered subset165 rules, not all75360 rules
No FDR portfolios or Sharpe selection reproduced
Bitstamp spot original replaced by Binance perpetual proxy with added funding
One minute open execution and monthly cash restart differ from paper
No native LBank warning, manual fill, stop, TP1 or 30day forward evidence
report: All monthly choices and selected sleeved ledgers; base and double costs, gross before costs, matched quality months, net return and drawdown, daily7day-block bootstrap2000 and candidate count. No production promotion from this partial test.
